        ### Question

Further into the encounter, the patient reveals that he has been on a mood stabilizer for bipolar disorder for several years. Which of the following is the most likely cause of his polyuria?

opc. Primary polydipsia
opd. Syndrome of inappropriate ADH secretion
ope. Urinary tract infection
